headline: Avoiding Common Pitfalls in Garage ADU Projects
articleBody: Embarking on a garage ADU conversion can be super exciting, offering extra space or income, but there are definitely some traps to watch out for. One big mistake is underestimating the budget. People often forget about things like utility hookups, architectural plans, or unexpected structural repairs. It's crucial to get a detailed estimate that covers everything, including a contingency fund for surprises. Another common issue is not fully understanding local zoning laws and permitting requirements. California has made ADUs easier, but specific rules vary from Orange County to Los Angeles areas. Skipping this step can lead to costly delays or even fines. Don't cut corners on design either; a poorly designed ADU can feel cramped or impractical. Think about natural light, flow, and how it will integrate with your main home or stand alone. Also, many folks try to DIY too much. While some aspects can be fun, electrical, plumbing, and structural work really need licensed professionals to ensure safety and code compliance. Finally, not vetting your contractor thoroughly can lead to major headaches. Make sure they’re licensed, insured, and have a good track record with ADU projects, just like us at Affordable Home Remodeling. Getting expert help early on can make all the difference.
